_note: Heals, shields and helmets, Season 30 (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md sections 1 to 3). Amounts in shield or health points (999: all of it), use times in seconds, stacks per inventory slot. While healing you move 40% slower and cannot sprint; sprinting, firing, aiming or a swap cancels; the item is spent when it finishes.
_kits: what you start a life with: the arena and the bot match get a fixed kit (ours: two of the big heals, four of the small); a battle royale starts empty and loots (the start kit is for when loot is off)
_shields: Shield cores (Season 20 on): you start at white 50; EVO (squad.json's sources: the damage you deal, knocks, assists, revives, care packages) takes it to blue 75 at 450 and purple 100 at 1,700 more, 2,150 in all (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 2.3; Phase 11 had 1,700 in all). Red 125 only from the mythic helmet. A level-up refilling the shield is ours (unverified for Season 30).
_helmets: Helmets cut no headshot damage since Season 24. The gold one sets your armour to 100 and doubles what cells and syringes heal (we double the amount; the source does not say amount or speed); the mythic (red) one sets it to 125.
